fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-40c7ef9f, attempt 2 at a1dc9868. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate -v: PASS (unstable runs the gate in the worktree, stable skips, no gate skips, failing gate fails with its output, plus OncePerHead). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow: ok (local-gate, gate-rebase, gate-land, gate-rebase-merge before the push steps of ship-change.toml, on.fail = gate-fix). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-local-gate|describe-golden)$': PASS; the script's own repo shows daemon settings --json with rhiza.ship.localGate project-scoped, empty default, source default, then daemon set to make check reading value make check from git config. The scripts had to run with TMPDIR set outside the repo and GOTMPDIR/RHIZA_ROOT unset: the run's GOTMPDIR sits under ~/code/rhiza/.git, so rhiza init in the script found the outer .rhiza (an environment issue, not the leaf). Diff read: removes the .rhiza/settings.json source, its test and golden wording, per Decision ship-local-gate-acceptance-from-commit; no leftover references; gofmt and vet clean on internal/api.
